background_incidence: 33 cases/100,000/yr (2005, national); 136-1,052 cases/100,000/yr (2006, WHO estimate, Northern division, "high" per WHO >=100/100,000); national annual incidence 44, 40, 52, 42 per 100,000/yr in 2008-2011
outbreak_frequency: At least 13 typhoid outbreaks reported in Fiji by media since 2005 (unpublished WHO-DPS data); recurrent outbreaks linked to cyclones (also Samoa)
endemicity: Endemic nationally, markedly focal; Northern division highest (94-176/100,000/yr, 2008-2011) vs Western (22-54) and Central (19-38)
seasonality: Seasonal peak Jan-July each year; cyclones common Nov-Apr, damaging WaSH infrastructure and preceding vaccination campaign
notes: Fiji, ViPS vaccine post-Cyclone Tomas 2010. High-vaccination subdivision (92%) IRR=0.23 (77% decrease); mid-level (22-65%) IRR=0.24-0.58; low/no-vaccination subdivisions incidence increased 2-8x
